fixture_rule: Base fixture = one main and one oracle owned_supervisor_v19 history, both closed and mutually consistent; each case changes only the named element of the MAIN history unless stated, re-pinning digests/ACK fields needed to isolate it. S = synthetic predicate fixture (no OS provenance claim); N = native case needing its own parent GO. Expected causes are exact ordered sets in U_CAUSES/E_CAUSES order; no broadening to absorb unrelated failures. V2: the base fixture contains no coverage_history entry, no identity-less helper/main spawn, no pending raw acquisition and no overflow observation; otherwise every case also carries U_UNKNOWN_INCARNATION. V3: every endedness/spec-match fixture union is built by v3 (module 'parent_release_identity_v3.py', design_freeze_sha256 033cb30dcde31ec94acbb0f8576f436e14bfaae980c8bff34e76932dd894cb5a, scheme 'sv19-incarnation-v1', producer_sha256 cb828a78...) unless the case alters it; otherwise E_UNION_VERSION is added.
